listing.name: Kameo: Elements of Power — Azkali KameoRecomp (Azkali)
listing.summary: This early project generates code that can be linked into a Kameo player. Most Xbox system functions remain unfinished in src/hooks.cpp; startup and gameplay are unconfirmed. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Extract your own Kameo Xbox 360 ISO with extract-xiso into assets/game/, keeping default.xex and all remaining game files. This guide does not specify exact accepted region, revision or executable hashes.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: For the source route, build and install ReXGlueSDK, run rexglue codegen Kameo_config.toml, then configure the Linux AMD64 CMake preset with REXSDK_DIR and compile using Clang 18+, CMake 3.25+ and Ninja. This guide does not identify a completed player release.

warnings: This early project generates code that can be linked into a Kameo player. Most Xbox system functions remain unfinished in src/hooks.cpp; startup and gameplay are unconfirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
